objective: Test a leakage-free one-entry online PWP memo on the six exact-binary Patch/early Conv3x3 modules against the strong one-source/96-lane add-only baseline.

source_geometry.source_partition: tap-major contiguous groups of 16 input channels

online_memo_policy.scope: reset invalid at every tap/channel partition
online_memo_policy.eligible: nonzero masks with population at least two
online_memo_policy.hit: one signed12 PWP update of 96 Acc19 destinations
online_memo_policy.miss: one INT8 weight-vector update per active source; a separate 96-lane signed12 builder shadows the same broadcasts and fills tag plus PWP without extra service cycles

same_resource_cycle_model.reference: one selected INT8 weight vector updates 96 destinations per cycle
same_resource_cycle_model.candidate: one miss-source or one PWP-hit updates the same 96 destinations per cycle; the fill builder is additional logic but not an additional destination-update port
same_resource_cycle_model.input_scan_and_output_commit: charged serially and identically to both points

promotion_gates.module_cycle_opportunity: all 60 records, all ten samples, and all six modules individually faster
promotion_gates.physical_claim: requires VCS plus matched DC/STA area and cache implementation

claim_boundary.admitted_if_pass: exact ordered-trace isolated Patch/early-Conv module-cycle opportunity for a leakage-free online one-entry PWP memo
not_admitted: PWP numeric RTL, cache macro, builder timing or area, VCS, DC, energy, complete Patch Embed, system speedup, paper PPA, or headline
the dense first patch head or PED shortcut outside the six exact-binary selected modules
